summary.name: Ellipsis
summary.one_liner: Ellipsis is a platform for running internal coding agents in the cloud, using Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI, extended with your own tools, secrets, and MCP servers.
use_cases: automated code review on pull requests
answering mentions on GitHub issues and PRs
triaging Slack or Linear requests with an agent
running scheduled or event-triggered agent tasks
capping agent spend per session or account
summary.what_it_does: The docs describe a CLI for installing the tool and starting an agent session. Agents can be triggered from GitHub (code review on each push and @ellipsis mentions on issues and PRs), Slack, Linear, and Sentry (the Sentry integration is noted as not generally released). Platform concepts include environments (installing tools and connecting MCP servers), sessions (start, follow, and send follow-ups to a task), models, webhooks for session changes, secrets for tokens and keys, GitHub permissions, and budgets capping spend. Supported harnesses listed are Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
notable: Runs Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI as cloud agent harnesses
Triggers from GitHub PRs, Slack, Linear, and Sentry
Per-session, per-agent, and per-account spend budgets
Custom environments with tools and MCP servers
caveats: Sentry integration is not generally released
Pricing not stated on the page
